title: MoM-APM Meeting Appdynamics
content:
Participants: Sambit, Arun, Niklas, Joakim, David, PA, Johan, Robert

Missed out: Christian, Anna and other team members from AppD the meeting was forwarded to.

 

MoM:

 

  1. Brief Individual introduction to the attendees.

  2. Briefing on IPEX applications, product delivery model , Key applications under consideration for monitoring etc. ( Sambit)

    1. Many planners in the IPEX area covering various business areas such as, Kitchen, Sofa, Storage, Bathroom, etc.

    2. Around 32+ applications

    3. Most of them are light weight client intensive 3D modeling application for designing. Heavily CDN driven .

    4. NKP or new kitchen planner is the most complex of all and has a higher demand on monitoring .

    5. Planners/application with SaaS, have components which are blackbox to us and don’t need to be monitored at our end unless there is a delivery structure with specific SLA on Inter-Ikea or a Vendor.

    6. Primary monitoring requirements

                                                              i.      Availability

                                                             ii.      Performance synthetic

                                                           iii.      INC monitoring (NKP is covered by Power BI, this is sorted)

                                                           iv.      RUM in specific case

                                                             v.      E2E error tracing and root cause analysis for All Other applications (AOA)

  1. Current challenges on monitoring requirement, where we are now in terms of the requirement gathering phase.

    1. We have gathered the requirements NKP which is finalized.

    2. For AoA (All other applications) we have some partial unattached requirement to any KPI or NFR in the respective applications.

    3. It’s continuous process and requirements will increase once we have better defined KPIs. We are working on that.

    4. NKP’s requirement is good enough to conduct  a result oriented POC.

    5. Sambit to Draft the POC document and have an internal alignment before connecting with App-D team for support.

    6. David and Robert can help to integrate with NKP during the POC process.

  2. App Dynamics Key capability discussion and brief walk-through of the tool. (Arun)

    1. Key components of the tool.

    2. How it fits in IKEA landscape.

    3. Various features.

    4. Discussion on Catchpoint and Splunk.

    5. Integrations with Catchpoint and Splunk.

    6. RUM capability.

 

Kindly add to the MoM if I have missed out on any key point of discussion.

 

Next Step:

 

  1. Sambit to conduct an internal alignment with David, Joakim and Robert and finalize POC scenarios and acceptance criteria.

  2. Sambit to connect with AppD team and plan POC and secure support.

  3. Target POC results week 17-19 in best possible scenario .
